sources.note: Nothing. Contents: lexicostatistics, noun classes, sec. 4.3 'Overview of segmental correspondences', diagnostic items, 600-item wordlists. Only prosodic remark, sec. 4.3 p.7: 'Tone is not covered in this paper in order to focus on the segmental correspondences.' Wordlists carry no tone or stress marks.

tone.says: SIL record 64363 abstract: overview of the relationship between OluHumbe, OluCilenge, OluKwandu, OluNgendelengo and OluKuvale (Zone R, SW Angola); lexical comparison, sound correspondences and noun classes; preliminary diagnostic items distinguishing the Nyaneka and Herero varieties of the area. SIL subject tags: Survey Report, Wordlist. No tone content is visible in the abstract; Glottolog classes it a wordlist or less.
